{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Display basic info
df_info = trial.info()

# Show first few rows
df_head = trial.head()

# Check for missing values in biomarker_final
df_missing = trial['biomarker_final'].isnull().sum()

# Check data types
df_dtypes = trial.dtypes

# Return all
print(df_info)
print('\n--- Head ---\n')
print(df_head)
print('\n--- Missing in biomarker_final ---\n')
print(df_missing)
print('\n--- Data Types ---\n')
print(df_dtypes)

# Also inspect the data dictionary
data_dict = open('data/data_dictionary.md', 'r').read()
print('\n--- Data Dictionary ---\n')
print(data_dict)"}
